name: sheet
title: Sheet
description: A panel that slides up from the bottom and can be dragged down to close.

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible name, and the heading at the top of the sheet.

a11y.text: Esc closes it, because it is a native modal dialog that traps focus and returns it to the opener on close. A click on the backdrop closes it too.
The dialog is labelled by title, which is also the h2 at the top. The grab handle is aria-hidden.
Under reduced motion the slide-in animation is off.

Dragging the top area (handle and title) down by more than 30% of the sheet's height closes it, and a shorter drag springs back. The drag is pointer only; Esc and a click on the backdrop close it too.
